explanation: The theorem is about the library's own morphism `SSet.tensorNormalizedChainComplexCoefficientMap` (a chain map between the library's `tensorNormalizedChainComplex`'s built from a surjective additive homomorphism `A →+ B`). No Mathlib declaration mentions this construction; Mathlib has no `tensorNormalized*`/`*Coefficient*` chain maps at all (grep over Mathlib found nothing). The only Mathlib ingredients used are the generic `HomologicalComplex.epi_of_epi_f` (Algebra/Homology/HomologicalComplex.lean) and `ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective`, plus the library-specific componentwise surjectivity lemma `tensorNormalizedCoefficientMap_surjective`. This is not a special case of either: deriving it from `epi_of_epi_f` requires supplying degreewise epimorphisms, which is exactly the substantive library-specific content (and already uses the library's own lemma), so no one- or two-line derivation from a Mathlib statement exists.
